'''Merris Kran''' was a [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. There, he trained fellow Imperials in the art of Bioanalysis.
